hooks.command: G=$(command -v graphify 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify"); [ -x "$G" ] || exit 0; exec "$G" hook-guard search
G=$(command -v graphify 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify"); [ -x "$G" ] || exit 0; exec "$G" hook-guard read
G=$(command -v graphify 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify"); [ -x "$G" ] || exit 0; exec "$G" hook-guard compact
